scope: Pre-implementation gate - test + task review for M8 Sizing Redesign

gaps.issue: No test file exercises the CapitalAllocationPolicy Protocol surface shipped in M8. The allocation-review.md Q1 mandated Protocol-in-M8 with SharedPoolPolicy default + sampling_cadence class attribute + AllocationState TypedDict. Task 7 creates v5/sizing/allocation.py but zero tests in the snapshot reference CapitalAllocationPolicy, SharedPoolPolicy, AllocationState, or sampling_cadence. The allocation-review explicitly called out 'test_m8_shared_pool_policy.py: 3 tests (identity, clock-now-ns pass-through, equivalence to today's behavior)' as scope. Without these tests the Protocol hook will ship untested and the 'zero retrofit cost in M9' argument is unverified.
gaps.fix_recommendation: Add test_m8_capital_allocation_policy.py with: (1) SharedPoolPolicy.available_capital returns state.available_margin (identity), (2) sampling_cadence class attribute is present with Literal['bar_close','tick','release'] value, (3) clock_now_ns is threaded through the Protocol call, (4) AllocationState TypedDict exposes exactly {available_margin, per_strategy_equity, rolling_pnl_24h, current_positions_notional}, (5) free_capital_clamp calls policy.available_capital(...) when passed a non-default policy, (6) funding_buffer subtraction happens BEFORE policy call per design section 7.1/8.3.

gaps.ac_or_design_ref: design Section B2 / task 24 / brief AC-Sz3
gaps.issue: test_m8_multi_leg_aggregation.py covers OTOCO and OCO but is MISSING the OTO/sum case explicitly called out in the module docstring (line 6: 'OTO: sum'). Design Section 3d and brief AC-Sz3 state 'OTO sums, OTOCO = entry+max(siblings), OCO = max' as three distinct rules. Only two are tested. The free-capital clamp branching for ContingencyType.OTO could ship wrong (silently summing OTOCO siblings, or treating OTO as OCO) and the snapshot will not catch it.
gaps.fix_recommendation: Add TestOtoSumAggregation class with a 2-leg OTO order, assert reserved_capital_for_clamp(order) == pytest.approx(leg_a_margin + leg_b_margin). Also add a NONE/single-leg control test distinguishing from OTO.

gaps.issue: test_m8_clamps_individual.py::TestLiquidationDistanceClamp has ONE test that passes liquidation_distance_bps as a scalar in market_state. Design/brief explicitly require 'Binance tiered maintenance-margin schedule (notional-bucketed) - test with a position spanning two tiers' (AC-Sz3 clause 5; task 12 notes 'Risk-reviewer focus target'). The current test does not exercise the tiered MMR lookup - it passes a hardcoded liquidation_distance_bps which bypasses the tier calculation entirely. The round-3 Risk-architect pass will flag this and ask why the clamp under test isn't actually computing liquidation from position size + leverage + tier schedule.
gaps.fix_recommendation: Add TestLiquidationDistanceTieredMMR with at least 2 parametrized cases: (a) notional that stays in tier 1 (0-50K USDT, MMR=0.5%) and (b) notional spanning tier 1->tier 2 boundary (e.g. 60K USDT on BTCUSDT where the marginal MMR rises). Assert the clamp uses the correct per-tier maintenance-margin rate and that liq distance differs from the naive 1/leverage formula. Reference Binance perp tier schedule as the source of truth.

gaps.issue: Brief explicitly lists 'TokenSignal fraction_of_equity bound: new AC in M8 scope, engine rejects or scales when aggregate fraction_of_equity * leverage exceeds 1.0 across active position book. Default: reject marginal signal; escape hatch allow_over_leveraged=True.' This requirement is in-scope for M8 (brief lines 251-253) but has ZERO test coverage in the snapshot - no tests reference allow_over_leveraged or aggregate leverage enforcement. Design section 7 open issue #3 says this is 'a new portfolio-level pre-clamp' but no task lands it and no test asserts it.
gaps.fix_recommendation: Either (a) add test_m8_aggregate_leverage_bound.py covering reject-default + allow_over_leveraged escape hatch + cross-strategy aggregation, AND add corresponding task to tasks.md; OR (b) explicitly descope the M7 carry-over #2 from M8 with a brief amendment. Ambiguity here means the implementer will either skip it (missing scope) or ship untested code (no TDD gate).

gaps.ac_or_design_ref: design Section 2 Modified files / design Section 8.4 FIX vocab

Amend Task 15 (or add task 15b) to include: (a) a docstring/schema comment tagging strategy_id as FIX StrategyID(1098), (b) a test assertion in test_m8_binding_log.py that documents the vocabulary anchor (currently none - the test just checks the field exists). gaps.issue: test_m8_binding_log.py correctly uses 'strategy_id' as the field name (7 occurrences, matching FIX-1098 vocabulary). There is NO regression into Party(448)/party_id vocabulary - good. If a future reviewer adds a 'party_id' field alongside, the test would still pass. test_m8_paper_backtest_parity.py NON_FLOAT_COLUMNS correctly includes 'strategy_id' but same observation applies.
gaps.fix_recommendation: Add a light assertion in TestBindingLogSchema documenting intent: e.g., 'assert "party_id" not in entry and "fix_448" not in entry' to prevent future drift into prime-broker give-up vocabulary. Low priority but cheap and catches future regressions.

gaps.ac_or_design_ref: brief Key AC item 9 (Dropped v4 checks disposition)

gaps.ac_or_design_ref: tasks.md Task 16 stop-triggers / M7 round-4 precedent
gaps.issue: tasks.md Stop-and-redecompose triggers (lines 226-229) list 4 triggers but miss a FIX-correctness mode seen in M7 round-4: a release_atomic mutation that breaks fix_audit_log append semantics (dataclass(frozen=True) + object.__setattr__ discipline). Task 16 rewrites release_atomic signature and Task 17 adds try/except - both touch the Order dataclass immutability invariant. If the implementer accidentally removes the frozen=True contract or forgets to use _replace-style copy in the clamp pipeline, the fix_audit_log tuple append will corrupt silently. M7 round-4 reviewer caught this inline and it cost a round.
gaps.fix_recommendation: Add a 5th stop-and-redecompose trigger: 'Task 16/17 mutation of Order state breaks frozen-dataclass invariant or fix_audit_log append semantics -> STOP; use _replace / object.__setattr__ pattern per M5 precedent.' Also consider adding test_m8_release_atomic_integration.py::test_order_remains_frozen_after_clamp_pipeline which calls order.some_field = X and asserts FrozenInstanceError.

gaps.ac_or_design_ref: AC-Sz8 / task 25 / M7 Fill triple contract
gaps.issue: test_m8_reduce_only_overfill.py asserts ExecType.TRADE + ExecType.REJECTED are emitted but does NOT assert the M7-shipped Fill triple (ClOrdID+OrderID+ExecID+TransactTime+LastQty+LastPx+CumQty+LeavesQty+AvgPx) is populated correctly on the reducing-portion fill. Under Binance venue behavior the partial-fill event needs LastQty=5, CumQty=5, LeavesQty=2 (pre-reject), then REJECTED with LeavesQty=0. The test as written does not catch an implementation that emits TRADE and REJECTED but with incorrect qty accounting.
gaps.fix_recommendation: Extend TestReduceOnlyLongOverfill::test_long_5x_reduce_7x_emits_partial_fill_plus_reject to also assert: trade_event.get('last_qty') == pytest.approx(5.0), trade_event.get('cum_qty') == pytest.approx(5.0), reject_event.get('leaves_qty') == pytest.approx(0.0). Covers M7 Fill invariant that this path must respect.

gaps.issue: test_m8_paper_backtest_parity.py imports PER_TRADE_PNL_BPS_TOLERANCE (5.0 bps) and PRICE_ULP_TOLERANCE (4 ULP) from shadow_replay_tolerances.py but does not import or use AGGREGATE_PNL_BPS_TOLERANCE (10.0 bps) per the task prompt's M3 tolerance-constants requirement (4/5/10). Not wrong per se - AC-Sz9 is per-fill not aggregate - but worth a comment tying the choice back to M3 convention so future maintainers know why the 10-bps tolerance is intentionally unused here.
gaps.fix_recommendation: Add a module-level comment: 'AGGREGATE_PNL_BPS_TOLERANCE (10 bps) is not applied here because AC-Sz9 is a per-fill parity gate. Aggregate-level drift is covered by M4 AC41 trade-archive parity.' Cheap docs clarification.

gaps.issue: design.md has TWO sections numbered '## 8' - '## 8. Multi-strategy capital allocation' and '## 8. Approval gate'. This is a documentation bug, not a correctness gap, but makes cross-references ambiguous (which '§8' does the allocation-review refer to?).
gaps.fix_recommendation: Renumber the second Section 8 to Section 9. Cosmetic - no implementation impact.

strengths: AC coverage is strong overall - 13 of 13 brief ACs plus 4 disposition items map to at least one test file. AC-Sz1 through Sz9 all have dedicated test files with named test classes.

FIX vocabulary is correct where tested: strategy_id field name (FIX-1098) is used consistently across test_m8_binding_log.py and test_m8_paper_backtest_parity.py NON_FLOAT_COLUMNS. No regression into Party(448) or party_id anywhere.

reduce_only overfill test covers all 3 mandated scenarios (long_5x_reduce_7x, short_3_reduce_5, flip_direction_attempt) with correct ExecType.TRADE + ExecType.REJECTED expectations and reject_reason='reduce_only_overfill' matches brief AC-Sz8 exactly.

AC-Sz9 paper-vs-backtest parity test uses M3 tolerance constants from the correct module (v5/tests/shadow_replay_tolerances.py), applies ULP tolerance for fill_price and bps tolerance for notional/margin/slippage per design. Byte-identity assertion on non-float columns (binding_constraint, intent, symbol, strategy_id) is tight and matches the prompt.
Clamp ordering test (test_m8_clamps_ordering.py) codifies the first-binding-wins semantics with a CLAMP_ORDER constant test, preventing silent reorder drift.

Cross-margin free-capital test (test_m8_cross_margin_free_capital.py) explicitly asserts isolated vs cross produce DIFFERENT values - catches the cross-margin formula bug the Risk review is scoped to find.
Clamp error containment test parametrizes all 6 clamp names, mirroring M7 AC-S5 error-containment pattern, and includes an explicit test that BarProcessor does not crash.
Task decomposition at 31 tasks in 12 waves is well-structured with explicit dependency notation. Critical path (1->3->10->14->15->16->22/23->28->31) is documented. Parallelizable tasks are flagged.

Design B1 (single clamp entry point in release_atomic) is verified by test_m8_release_atomic_integration.py asserting simulator.py and paper_engine.py do NOT import apply_clamps directly - strong architectural guard.
summary: Phase 3 gate is APPROVE_WITH_GAPS. The 140-test / 15-file snapshot has good architectural coverage - AC-Sz1 through AC-Sz9 all map to dedicated test files, FIX vocabulary is correct (strategy_id per FIX-1098, not Party 448), reduce_only semantics cover all 3 Binance scenarios, and the paper-vs-backtest parity test correctly uses M3 tolerance constants. Four MAJOR gaps must close before implementation: (1) the CapitalAllocationPolicy Protocol surface shipped in M8 per allocation-review Q1 has zero tests - no SharedPoolPolicy identity test, no sampling_cadence assertion, no AllocationState TypedDict shape test; (2) multi-leg OTO sum-aggregation is documented but untested (only OTOCO and OCO are covered); (3) liquidation-distance clamp test does not exercise Binance tiered MMR as AC-Sz3 clause 5 and task 12 require - it passes a pre-computed bps value rather than computing from position*leverage*tier; (4) M7 carry-over aggregate fraction_of_equity*leverage bound (brief lines 251-253) is in scope but has zero tests and no task. Four MINOR gaps (FIX-vocab regression guard assertions, funding_buffer ordering + max_sizing_equity tests, frozen-dataclass stop-trigger, Fill-triple assertions on reduce_only partial), two NITs (tolerance comment, duplicate §8 numbering). Recommend closing the 4 MAJORs before Phase 4 kickoff; MINORs and NITs can fold into the first reviewer round. Test immutability (Phase 4) will otherwise lock in these blind spots across 60-85h of implementation.
